# Elyssa

Elyssa is an IMDb-like movie and TV database frontend application.

## Pages

- [Home](/) - Featured titles, trending, and top rated
- [Browse](/browse) - Browse all titles with filters
- [Search](/search) - Search for titles and people
- [Title Detail](/title/tt0000001) - View title information, cast, and ratings
- [Person Detail](/person/nm0000001) - View person filmography and biography
